harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: «فاطر»: naʿt (adjective) of the Divine Name; «جاعل»: a second naʿt. «رسلا»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the active participle «جاعل». «أولي»: naʿt [of] «رسلا», interpreted as a derived word; it is attached to the sound masculine plural and is genitive with the yāʾ. «مثنى»: naʿt of «أجنحة»; it is a diptote, and likewise what follows it. The clause «يزيد» is resumptive. The preposition «على كل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قدير».

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: «ما»: conditional, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first. The preposition «من رحمة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ما». The clause «فلا ممسك لها» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The second «ما» is like the first. The preposition «من بعده» is attached to the [notion of] being established (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached. The clause «وهو العزيز» is resumptive, and «الحكيم» is a second khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «الناس»: ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). The preposition «عليكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «نعمة». «هل من خالق»: [«خالق» is a] mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); what permitted beginning with an indefinite noun is that an interrogative precedes it. «غير» is an adjective of «خالق» according to its position, and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "deserving of worship". The clause «يرزقكم» is a second naʿt (adjective) of «خالق». «هو» is a badal (substitute) of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the omitted khabar. The clause of declaring [Allah] transcendent is resumptive, and the clause «فأنى تؤفكون» is resumptive; «وأنَّى» is an interrogative noun, ḥāl.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: The preposition «من قبلك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رسل», and the clause «ترجع الأمور» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The clause «إن وعد الله حق» is resumptive, and the clause «فلا تغرنَّكم» is conjoined to the resumptive [clause].

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The preposition «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عدو». The clause «فاتخذوه» is conjoined to the resumptive [clause] «إن الشيطان عدو». «عدوًّا»: second object.

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The clause «لهم عذاب» is the khabar (predicate) of the relative noun that is the mubtadaʾ (subject); likewise the clause «لهم مغفرة» is the khabar of the second relative noun.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: His words «أفمن»: the hamza is interrogative, and «من» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being: like one whom Allah has guided. The clause «فرآه» is conjoined to the clause «زُيِّنَ». «حسنا»: the second object of «رأى» of the heart (i.e. of mental perception). The clause «فإن الله..» is resumptive, and the clause «فلا تذهب» is resumptive. His words «حَسَرات»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) for intensiveness, as though it had become all regrets out of excessive regret. «بما»: a relative noun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عليم».

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The clause «والله الذي أرسل» is resumptive, and the [following] clauses are conjoined. The clause «كذلك النشور» is resumptive; the kāf is a noun meaning "like", khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «النشور».

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: «من»: a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «فلله العزة» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e.: let him seek it from Allah. «جميعًا»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the second «العزة». The clause «والعمل الصالح يرفعه» is conjoined to the clause «يصعد». The clause «والذين يمكرون» is conjoined to the conditional clause. The clause «هو يبور» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «مكر».

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «والله خلقكم» is resumptive, and «أزواجا» is a second object. «أنثى»: fāʿil (agent), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). The preposition «بعلمه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أنثى». «معمر»: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and «مِنْ» is redundant. The preposition «في كتاب» is attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: except that it is in a Book. The preposition «على الله» is attached to «يسير».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The clause «وما يستوي البحران» is resumptive, and the clause «هذا عذب» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «البحران». His words «سائغ»: a second khabar (predicate), and «شرابه» is the fāʿil (agent) of «سائغ». The preposition «ومن كل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تأكلون». The clause «تلبسونها» is a naʿt (adjective) of «حلية». The clause «وترى الفلك» is conjoined to «وما يستوي البحران». «مواخر»: ḥāl from «الفلك», and the preposition «فيه» is attached to «مواخر». The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive, «لتبتغوا» is attached to «مواخر». The clause «ولعلكم تشكرون» is conjoined to the genitive single [word] of seeking (الابتغاء).

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The clause «يولج» is resumptive. The clause «كل يجري» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الشمس والقمر». The clause «ذلكم الله» is resumptive; «ربكم» is a badal (substitute), and the clause «له الملك» is a second khabar (predicate). The clause «والذين تدعون» is conjoined to the clause «ذلكم الله»; «قطمير» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The conditional clause is resumptive, and the second conditional clause is conjoined to the first. The clause «يكفرون» is conjoined to the second conditional clause, and the adverb «يوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يكفرون». The clause «ولا ينبئك مثل» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: «الناس»: ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). The preposition «إلى الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «الفقراء». The clause «والله هو الغني» is conjoined to the response to the vocative, and «هو» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: (إن يشأ يذهبكم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The conditional clause is resumptive within the scope of the response to the vocative.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: «ما» is a negating particle acting like «ليس», and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in its khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined to the preceding conditional clause.

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The clause «ولا تزر وازرة» is resumptive, and the conditional clause is conjoined to the resumptive [clause]. The preposition «منه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يحمل». The clause «ولو كان ذا قربى» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the one called upon, understood from the context, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. This wāw conjoins to an implied ḥāl for exhaustiveness, i.e.: nothing of it will be carried in any state, even in this state; and the noun of «كان» refers to the one called upon, understood from the context. The preposition «بالغيب» is attached to an implied ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent). The conditional clause «ومن تزكى» is resumptive, and the clause «وإلى الله المصير» is conjoined to the conditional clause.

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: (وما يستوي الأعمى والبصير) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: «لا» is redundant (zāʾida), to emphasise the negation, in both places.

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The clause «وما أنت بمسمع» is conjoined to the clause «إن الله يُسْمع», and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar (predicate) of «ما». The preposition «في القبور» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause).

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: «إن» is negating, «إلا» is for restriction, and [the rest is] a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The preposition «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object. «بشيرًا»: ḥāl from the kāf. The clause «إن من أمة ...» is conjoined to the clause «إنا أرسلناك»; «إن» is negating, «أمة» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and «من» is redundant (zāʾida), and the clause «خلا» is the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ}. The clause «جاءتهم رسلهم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun. The preposition «بالبينات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جاءتهم».

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The clause «ثم أخذت» is conjoined to the clause {كَذَّبَ}, and the clause «فكيف كان نكير» is conjoined to the clause «أخذت الذين». «كيف»: an interrogative noun, khabar (predicate) of «كان»; «نكير» is the noun of «كان», nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the letter before the omitted yāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أنَّ» and what follows it takes the place of the two objects of «تر». «مختلفًا»: naʿt (adjective) of «ثمرات», and «ألوانها» is the fāʿil (agent) of the active participle «مختلفًا». The clause «ومن الجبال جدد» is conjoined to the resumptive [clause] «ألم تر». «غرابيب»: a noun conjoined to «حمر»; «سود»: badal (substitute).

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The preposition «من الناس» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first, of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «مختلف», which was originally a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted described noun, i.e.: a varied kind; the clause is conjoined to the preceding clause {أَلَمْ تَرَ}. «ألوانه» is the fāʿil (agent) of «مختلف». His words «كذلك»: the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: varied with a variation like that variation in the fruits. «إنما»: the restraining [ما] and the restrained [إنّ] (kāffa wa-makfūfa). The preposition «من عباده» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «العلماء».

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The preposition «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أنفقوا». «سرًا»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a kind of the maṣdar (verbal noun). The clause «يرجون» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and the clause «لن تبور» is a naʿt (adjective) of «تجارة».

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «ليوفيهم» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) {يَرْجُونَ}. The clause «إنه غفور» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: The clause «والذي أوحينا ...» is resumptive; the khabar (predicate) of the relative noun is «الحق», and the pronoun (هو) is for separation. The preposition «من الكتاب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الذي». «مصدقًا»: ḥāl from «الحق». «ما»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «مصدقًا», and the lām is redundant (zāʾida), for strengthening. «بين»: an adverb of place attached to the implied ṣila (relative clause). The preposition «بعباده» is attached to «خبير».

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The two objects of «أورثنا» are «الكتاب» and «الذين». The preposition «من عبادنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun. The clause «فمنهم ظالم» is conjoined to the clause «اصطفينا». The preposition «لنفسه» is attached to «ظالم», the preposition «بالخيرات» is attached to «سابق», and the preposition «بإذن» is attached to the active participle «سابق». «هو»: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl).

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: «جنات»: badal (substitute) of {الْفَضْلُ الْكَبِيرُ}. The clause «يدخلونها» is a naʿt (adjective), and the clause «يحلون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «يدخلونها». The preposition «من أساور» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يحلون», and the preposition «من ذهب» is attached to a naʿt of «أساور». His words «ولؤلؤًا»: a noun conjoined to the position of «من أساور». The clause «ولباسهم فيها حرير» is conjoined to the clause «يحلون», and the preposition «فيها» is attached to a ḥāl from «لباسهم».

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The clause «وقالوا» is resumptive; the relative noun is a naʿt (adjective) of the Divine Name, and the clause «إن ربنا لغفور» is parenthetical.

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: «الذي»: badal (substitute) of the first relative noun. «دار»: second object. The preposition «من فضله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «أحلَّنا». The clause «لا يمسنا» is a ḥāl from «دار».

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The clause of the relative noun is resumptive, and the clause «لهم نار» is the khabar (predicate) of the relative noun; the clause «لا يُقضى» is a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject). His words «فيموتوا»: the fāʾ is causal (sababiyya), and the verb is an imperfect, accusative by an implied «أن» after the fāʾ; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e.: there is no decree [upon them], and so [no] death. The kāf in «كذلك» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: We recompense with a recompense like that recompense. The clause «نجزي» is parenthetical between the two conjoined [elements].

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: The clause «وهم يصطرخون» is conjoined to the clause «لا يخفف عنهم». The vocative clause is the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied speech that is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: saying, "Our Lord". The clause «نعمل» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition. «صالحًا»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «غير»: naʿt (adjective) of «صالحًا»; «الذي»: muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct). The clause «أولم نعمركم» is resumptive. «ما» is an indefinite described noun, i.e.: a time in which [one] would reflect, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; it is not temporal maṣdar-forming, because the pronoun in «فيه» prevents that, as it refers back to «ما», and the maṣdar-forming [ما] is a particle to which no pronoun refers back. The preposition «فيه» is attached to the verb. «مَنْ»: a relative noun, fāʿil (agent). The clause «يتذكر» is a naʿt of «ما». The clause «وجاءكم النذير» is conjoined to the clause «نعمِّركم». The clause «فذوقوا» is resumptive, and the clause «فما للظالمين من نصير» is conjoined to the clause «ذوقوا»; «نصير» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «من» is redundant (zāʾida), and the preposition «للظالمين» is attached to the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: The clause «هو الذي» is resumptive. «خلائف»: second object, and the preposition «في الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خلائف». The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause «جعلكم». «مقتًا»: second object of «يزيد», and the adverb «عند» is attached to «يزيد». The clause «لا يزيد» is conjoined to the conditional clause; «كفرهم» is a fāʿil (agent) placed later, and «خسارا» is a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: «أرأيتم»: meaning "tell me", and it takes two objects: the first is «شركاءكم», and the second is the interrogative clause «ماذا خلقوا». «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «شركاءكم». The preposition «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun. The clause «أروني» is parenthetical. «ما»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «ذا»: a relative noun, khabar (predicate). The preposition «من الأرض» is attached to a ḥāl from the relative noun «ذا». «أم» is disjoined (munqaṭiʿa), for turning away (iḍrāb). The preposition «في السماوات» is attached to «شِرك». «كتابًا»: second object. The clause «فهم على بينت» [Translator's note: so written; the Quranic text reads «بينة»] is conjoined to the clause «آتيناهم», and the preposition «فيه» is attached to a naʿt of «بينة». The clause «إن يَعِدُ» is resumptive, and «إن» is negating. «بعضهم»: badal (substitute) of the fāʿil (agent); «بعضًا»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and «غرورًا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is the kind of the maṣdar (verbal noun); the implied form is: a promise of delusion.

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تزولا» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: out of aversion to their ceasing; the verb «تزولا» is complete (tāmm), and the alif is the pronoun that is its fāʿil (agent). The clause «ولئن زالتا» is conjoined to the resumptive [clause] «إن الله....». The lām in «لئن» is the one that prepares [for the oath] (al-muwaṭṭiʾa). The second «إن» is negating, and «أحد» is the fāʿil, «من» being redundant (zāʾida). The preposition «من بعده» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «أحد». «غفورًا»: second khabar (predicate). The clause «إن أمسكهما» is the answer to the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The clause «وأقسموا» is resumptive. «جهد»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is the kind of the maṣdar (verbal noun). The clause «لئن جاءهم» is explicative of the swearing, and the lām is the preparatory one (al-muwaṭṭiʾa). The clause «ليكونن» is the answer to the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath. The verb is a defective imperfect, nominative by the retention of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of identical [letters], and the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil (agent). «أهدى»: khabar (predicate) of «كان», and the preposition «من إحدى» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أهدى». The conditional clause «فلما ...» is conjoined to the clause «لئن جاءهم», and the clause «ما زادهم» is the apodosis of «لما». «نفورًا»: second object.

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: «استكبارًا»: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). The preposition «في الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «استكبارًا». His words «ومكر»: a noun conjoined to {نُفُورًا}; the implied form is: and the plotting of evil work, with the described noun omitted. The clause «ولا يحيق» is parenthetical between the two conjoined [elements]. The interrogative clause is conjoined to the clause {فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ}, and «إلا» is for restriction. The clause «فلن تجد» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The clause «أولم يسيروا» is resumptive. «كيف»: an interrogative noun, khabar (predicate) of «كان», and the clause «كيف كان» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the looking, which is suspended [from operating] by the interrogative and carries the sense of knowing. The preposition «من قبلهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the ṣila (relative clause). The clause «وكانوا أشدَّ» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the preposition «منهم» is attached to «أشدَّ», and «قوة» is a tamyīz (specification). The clause «وما كان الله» is resumptive; the lām is of denial (lām al-juḥūd), and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive, is attached to the khabar of «كان», implied as "intending" (مريدًا). «شيء» is the fāʿil (agent) of «يعجزه», and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). The preposition «في السماوات» is attached to «يعجزه».

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. The bāʾ is a preposition and «ما» is maṣdar-forming; the maṣdar (verbal noun) (بكسبهم) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يؤاخذ». «دابة»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). The clause «ولكن يؤخرهم» is conjoined to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause «فإذا جاء أجلهم» is conjoined to the clause «يؤخرهم»; the clause «جاء» is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct). The preposition «بعباده» is attached to «بصيرا».
